title: Custom Message Blocker
description: The mod included in this project is a little mod I've been working on that adds the ability to not show certain chat messages. They can be messages which contain a word you don't want to see, or an EXACT word you don't want to see.
body:
## Custom Message Blocker

Tired of certain words or phrases cluttering your chat? **Custom Message Blocker** lets you automatically hide certain chat messages containing (or exactly matching) phrases you don't want to see.

### Features

- **Custom filter rules** — Add as many blocked phrases as you want
- **Two modes:**
  - `CONTAINS` — blocks any message that includes your phrase anywhere
  - `EXACT` — blocks only messages where your phrase is the actual message sent
- **On/off switch** — disable the entire mod if you wish.
- **Optional alerts** — get a subtle action bar notification when a message is blocked, so you know filtering is working
- **In-game config GUI** — manage all your rules visually, no config file editing required
- **Keybind & command support** — open settings with `\` (rebindable) or `/blockerconfig`
- **100% client-side** — works on any server

### How to Use

1. Press `\` (default keybind) or run `/blockerconfig` to open the GUI
2. Type a phrase you want blocked and choose `CONTAINS` or `EXACT` mode
3. Click **+ Add Rule**
4. Done!

### Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21+
- Fabric Loader 0.15.0+
- Fabric API
- Java 21+
